description:
Audiobook of the third and final entry of the original "Miss Nelson" book series. Written by Harry Allard. Illustrated by James Marshall. Presented in 4K. Read by Riggan Reads.

"Miss Nelson Has A Field Day" sees the Smedley Tornadoes football team in dire straits. Winless, scoreless and hapless the entire season, panic sets in when the school realizes the next game is against the mighty Central Werewolves on Thanksgiving Day. When Coach Armstrong is sent home with the "measles", a familiar witch in an ugly black sweat suit hits the field to take his place and whip the team into shape.

description:
Audiobook of the classic children's story "Miss Nelson Is Missing." Written by Harry Allard. Illustrated by James Marshall. Presented in 4K. Read by Riggan Reads.

The story follows Miss Nelson; a sweet elementary school teacher saddled with an unruly bunch of rude children. Unable to control their antics and disobedience, Miss Nelson suddenly disappears. The kids plans to wreak even more havoc in her absence go horribly awry when they're greeted by the evil Miss Viola Swamp... who takes over the classroom with an iron fist as the once villainous student-body now trembles in fear. Where is Miss Nelson?
